hooks.command: grep -qE '"git commit|"git merge' && (cd /c/Users/puror/velo-oracle-prime && npx gitnexus analyze 2>&1 | tail -3) || true

BRANCH=$(git -C /c/Users/puror/velo-oracle-prime branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); DIRTY=$(git -C /c/Users/puror/velo-oracle-prime status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"VELO Prime loaded. Branch: $BRANCH | Uncommitted: $DIRTY files\"}"
DIRTY=$(git -C /c/Users/puror/velo-oracle-prime status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"VELO session ended. Uncommitted: $DIRTY files\"}"
